newsitem.title: USA: Buckle September same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Buckle September same store sales rise.

text.p: The Buckle Inc said Thursday its same store sales for the five-weeks ended October 5, 1996 rose 10 percent from sales for the comparable five-week period in the prior year.
Total sales in September increased 21.2 percent to $20.2 million from $16.7 million in the corresponding five-week period of 1995, the specialty retailer said in a statement.

Year-to-date same store sales were up 14 percent over the comparable period last year. Net sales for the year-to-date, 35 weeks ended October 5, 1996, increased 23.6 percent to $130.0 million from $105.2 million for the corresponding 35 weeks in the prior year.
Buckle, a retailer of casual apparel for men and women, operates 178 retail stores in 22 states.
